NOT REBASED: the permission system refused `git rebase main`, so the branch is still on f50bc56. Read-only `git merge-tree --write-tree main HEAD` exits 0 with no conflicts (tree 4baac541); MainActivity's corrected sentence sits next to main's p-safe-area-native edits and merges cleanly.

Files: src/platform/keyboardReveal.ts (pure decision, isEditableControl, topInset), keyboardReveal.test.ts (16 tests), src/platform/keyboardHeight.ts (height source), src/app/providers/KeyboardAvoidance.tsx (DOM wiring, mounted once in AppProviders), AuthLayout.tsx (handler removed), ui/recipes/overlay.ts, ui/recipes/auth.ts, ui/tokens/tokens-core.css, MainActivity.java (one comment sentence only).
Height: Android = be:keyboard event; web = navigator.virtualKeyboard (overlaysContent=true) else visualViewport (0 when pinch-zoomed or no editable focused); web also sets --be-keyboard-height.

Reveal: on keyboard open, height change or focusin while open, one rAF later. Field span plus aria-describedby hint/error within 48 px below; for the last editable field of a form, plus the form's submit buttons when field and buttons fit together. Bottom 16 px above the keyboard; top 16 px below max(pinned header/nav/[role=status] bar, --be-safe-top).

Scroller: nearest overflow-auto/scroll ancestor that can absorb the delta, else the document; inside [aria-modal] never the document and no bar, status-bar floor still applies. If that aria-modal panel has running animations/transitions (be-sheet-up 320 ms, padding ease), wait for them to finish, then plan one frame later. Smooth scroll, 'auto' under reduced motion. Never with keyboard 0.

Room: SHEET_PANEL pb = space-6 + max(safe-bottom, keyboard), lg pb = 7*spacing + keyboard, eased with motion-safe transition-[padding-bottom] over --be-dur-base; main margin-bottom: var(--be-keyboard-height) in tokens-core.css (@layer base); AUTH_SHELL keeps its pb. All 0 when closed.
Inset split: auth.ts AUTH_NARRATIVE/AUTH_PANEL_AREA/AUTH_FOOTNOTE and overlay.ts SHEET_PANEL/BLOCK_LAYER use pl from safe-left, pr from safe-right; lg overrides still win.

MainActivity.java: only the sentence 'One surface ... only that surface consumes it.' changed to say the focused field moves and the web layer's keyboard avoidance consumes the height for every field. No code, no new comment.
Compat (rule 11): frontend only plus one Java comment; no API, contract, storage or data change; be:keyboard/--be-keyboard-height contract unchanged.

Measure in DevTools after each tap: k=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--be-keyboard-height')); r=document.activeElement.getBoundingClientRect(); innerHeight-k-r.bottom >= 16 (below the hint/error line, or below the submit button for a form's last field when it fits); r.top >= header bottom, or >= status bar on auth pages.

1 Client /profile/contact: tap Current password in Change your phone number (last field: Change phone number button should also clear the keyboard when it fits), then New phone number.
2 Client Support: tap What happened (textarea + hint; last field, so Send should also clear when it fits); then Subject: scrolls only if hidden.
3 Client /profile/reviews: tap Comment (optional): field and its submit button above the keyboard; scroll to the end with the keyboard open: last control clears it, bottom nav not lifted.

4 Admin /content/faqs: tap Edit on a draft, then Order (hint Lower numbers appear first.): Order, hint and the save button above the keyboard if they fit; then Question: comes down from under the top bar if hidden. Do not save.

6 Admin /client-values/payment-sheet: tap Amount on the last row; Date opens a picker. Do not record.

7 Sign-in (client /login, admin sign-in): tap Email: field clears the keyboard; then Next to Password: Password AND the Sign in button sit above the keyboard on a phone where both fit; the panel never goes under the status bar.

8 Optional, if a maturity is due on dev: admin client > maturity > Send or Resolve dialog > follow-up SIP > Number of months. The sheet finishes rising, its bottom padding eases up (no jump), then the field is scrolled above the keyboard; the page behind does not move. Do not send.

Commits on track/p-keyboard-fields: 1e6d0b7 feat(frontend): lift every focused field above the on-screen keyboard; cb26208 fix(ui): pad auth and sheet surfaces on the right from the right inset (coordinator addition).

What changed: src/platform/keyboardReveal.ts (pure decision + isEditableControl + topInset), keyboardReveal.test.ts (13 tests), src/platform/keyboardHeight.ts (height source), src/app/providers/KeyboardAvoidance.tsx (DOM wiring), mounted once in AppProviders next to SystemBarsController.

Height source: Android = MainActivity be:keyboard event (var already set natively); web = navigator.virtualKeyboard (overlaysContent=true, geometrychange) else visualViewport (innerHeight - height - offsetTop, 0 when pinch-zoomed or no editable focused); web also sets --be-keyboard-height.

Reveal: on keyboard open / height change / focusin while open, one rAF later. Editable = input except checkbox/radio/button/submit/range/file, textarea, select, contenteditable. Field span extends to aria-describedby hint/error lines starting within 48 px below it.

Target: bottom <= innerHeight - keyboard - 16, top below pinned top bar + 16 (top bar = fixed/sticky header|nav|[role=status] in the upper half overlapping the field). Nearest overflow-auto/scroll ancestor that can absorb the delta, else the document; inside [aria-modal] never the document and no top bar. Smooth, 'auto' under reduced motion. Never with keyboard 0.

Room: SHEET_PANEL pb = space-6 + max(safe-bottom, keyboard), lg pb = 7*spacing + keyboard; main gets margin-bottom: var(--be-keyboard-height) in tokens-core.css (@layer base) so the room sits inside the shell and the sticky bottom nav cannot rise. AUTH_SHELL keeps its pb. All are 0 when the keyboard is closed.
AuthLayout: local be:keyboard handler removed. It centred the field even when visible and missed focus moves; now just-enough plus hint room, focus moves, web too.

Inset split (coordinator 2026-11-18): auth.ts AUTH_NARRATIVE/AUTH_PANEL_AREA/AUTH_FOOTNOTE and overlay.ts SHEET_PANEL/BLOCK_LAYER now pl from safe-left, pr from safe-right, same floors. lg:px-10/lg:pl-8/lg:p-7 still win at lg (checked order in built CSS).

Kept: adjustNothing, interactive-widget=overlays-content, MainActivity IME stripping (4c42c9a). No shells/**, shellClient/shellAdmin/layout.ts, NetworkStatusProvider, app/native/**, android/**, whats-new touched.

Compat (rule 11): frontend only; no API, contract, storage or data change. Same --be-keyboard-height / be:keyboard contract with MainActivity; each APK ships its own bundle, so released APKs and the rollback target are unaffected.

Tests: keyboardReveal.test.ts 13 tests. Red controls (isolated mutation, restored, cmp identical): 85a3af7f no-keyboard guard dropped (1 failed); 9ef1a948 hasRoom always true (1 failed); 24b447ae scroll ancestors ignored (3 failed); 83de0c24 top-bar case removed (2 failed).

Green on cb26208, clean tree: contracts npm ci && build 5137cf33; frontend npm ci && npm run check 34a12c01 (59 files, 524 tests, api drift clean, 61 chunks boot, phonepe target ok); build:android 7d92380e (72 assets, 987746 B); build:android:admin c0c93d2c (104 assets, 1355741 B, 92 chunks); build:client 34aa1ab7; build:admin 503e4bc7.
Evidence level: STATIC + TESTED. No emulator, adb or browser run by this lane: RUNTIME UNVERIFIED.

Emulator prerequisite: the AVD has hw.keyboard=yes, which shows only Gboard's floating bar; set hw.keyboard=no and cold boot (or use the phone). Date and month inputs open a picker, not the keyboard, so they are not expected to move.

Measure in DevTools (chrome://inspect) after each tap: k=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--be-keyboard-height')); r=document.activeElement.getBoundingClientRect(); gap=innerHeight-k-r.bottom. Expect k>0 and gap>=16 (>=16 below the hint/error line where one shows), r.top below the header bottom.

Shell stillness each time: document.querySelector('header').getBoundingClientRect().top and nav[aria-label=Sections] bottom (=innerHeight) unchanged before and after the keyboard opens; nothing resizes.

1 Client Profile > Contact details (/profile/contact): tap Change your phone number > Current password (lowest field), then New phone number. Each rises to sit >=16 px above the keyboard; page scrolls only as far as needed.
2 Client Support (/profile > Support): tap What happened (textarea with hint). Textarea plus its hint line sit above the keyboard; then tap Subject: no scroll if already visible, else just enough.

3 Client Reviews (/profile/reviews): tap Comment (optional). It and the Send button area above the keyboard as far as the room allows; scroll to the end of the page with the keyboard open: last control clears the keyboard, bottom nav stays under the keyboard, not lifted.

4 Admin FAQ (/content/faqs): tap Edit on a draft, then tap Order (hint Lower numbers appear first.). Order and its hint sit >=16 px above the keyboard; then tap Question: it scrolls back down below the top bar if it was under it. Do not save.
5 Admin Create client (/users/create): tap Phone (lowest). It and any hint/error line rise above the keyboard; Full name tapped after scrolls down from under the top bar if hidden. Do not submit.
6 Admin payment sheet (/client-values/payment-sheet): tap the Amount field of the last row. It rises above the keyboard; the Date field opens a picker. Do not record.
7 Sign-in (client /login and admin sign-in): tap Email, then Password via the keyboard's Next. Each sits >=16 px above the keyboard; the panel no longer re-centres a field that is already visible.

8 Optional bottom sheet with text inputs, if a maturity is due on dev: admin client > maturity > Send or Resolve dialog, follow-up SIP > Number of months. The sheet body scrolls (or the short sheet grows) so the field is above the keyboard; the page behind does not scroll. Do not send.
Web (phone Chrome on the dev stack): same steps; Chrome uses navigator.virtualKeyboard, so --be-keyboard-height must become >0 when the keyboard opens.
Doubt 1: the sign-in panel now scrolls just enough instead of centring; Password can stay under the keyboard until it is focused. Coordinator to judge against 'same or better'.
Doubt 2: MainActivity's comment says only the sign-in panel consumes the height; it is now stale (rule 18) but android/** is outside this lane.

Doubt 3: the main margin rule lives in tokens-core.css because ui/recipes/layout.ts (PAGE_BASE) belongs to p-shell-polish; it could move there later. Top-bar detection relies on the shells keeping header/nav elements.
Doubt 4: Firefox Android honouring overlays-content reports no keyboard on the visualViewport path, so no avoidance there; pinch-zoomed web reports 0 by design.
